recipes.name: Homemade Masala Chai Concentrate (Spiced Milk Tea)
ingredients: 15 green cardamom pods or 6 black cardamom (I used a mix of these)
¼ tsp fresh grated or ground nutmeg
⅓ cup (45g) fresh ginger rough chopped
½ cup (23g) loose leaf black tea
instructions: Take your green/black cardamom, cinnamon sticks, black peppercorns and cloves and place in a baking sheet; toasting them at 350℉ for 6 - 8 minutes.
Once toasted, combine your spices with 1 quart of filtered water in a pot. Add in your ginger which has been roughly chopped, your granulated sugar, orange peels and ground nutmeg.
Bring your mixture up to a boil over medium-high heat, then immediately reduce it down to a low simmer and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and allow it to cool for 30 seconds. Drop in ½ cup of loose leaf black tea. Let it steep for 4-5 minutes.
Strain your mixture and reserve your liquid.
